intro: Timor-Leste covers the eastern half of the island of Timor, plus the Oecusse exclave and two small islands.

chapters.title: Mountains and reefs
text: Rugged mountains run down the middle; Mount Ramelau, 2,986 m, is the highest. The surrounding seas are part of the Coral Triangle, with some of the richest reefs in the world.
Atauro Island has some of the highest numbers of reef fish species ever recorded.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The climate is tropical, with a wet season from about December to April.

keyTerms.meaning: Part of a country separated from the rest.
